newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain needs low wages for a longer recovery -Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain needs low wages for a longer recovery -Rato.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato reiterated on Thursday that Spain needs to continue reforms and keep wages low in order to make the recovery last longer.

"Spain has entered in a very hopeful time...it's very likely in the coming months we'll have very good news about new jobs and growth...but wage inflation running at double the inflation rate could put a limit to the creation of employment," Rato told reporters before his speech at a seminar in Madrid.
"The Spanish economy is growing and it is creating new jobs at a very intense rate. We have to continue in that direction," he added.

Rato reiterated that overly high wage inflation could endanger the creation of new jobs, and added that the competitiveness of the Spanish economy and a public deficit under control were also other mayor targets.
